desc: Derive and formally verify the DP states for a subtree attached to its parent, including the “contains degree 4” condition.
Derive the transition for a top vertex with no selected parent, handling exactly 1 or exactly 4 selected children and excluding structures without any degree-4 vertex.
Design an \(O(N)\) implementation that obtains the rooted postorder iteratively and computes the largest required child contributions without sorting all child values.
Check edge cases such as \(N<5\), paths, stars, vertices with fewer than 3/4 rooted children, and the case where no alkane exists.
Produce the final Python solution with fast input, iterative traversal, 64-bit-safe integer handling, and the required output format.
